mechanisms.mechanism: The new route returns a note to any signed-in user who names its id. It looks the note up with `store.get()` and does not compare the owner of the note with the user of the session, as the two existing routes for one note do.
mechanisms.trigger: A user sends `GET /notes/<id>/download` with their own session and the id of another user's note: 200 and the text of that note.
mechanisms.why_severity: An exploitable security flaw is P0 on the plugin's scale: any account reads every note by counting ids.

note: No acceptance criterion names the owner; the request says "one of their notes", and the fixture's AGENTS.md states the rule. The case asks whether the security rubric is applied.
